items.quote: Only thou shalt not number the tribe of Levi, neither take the sum of them among the children of Israel:
items.claim: The LORD told Moses not to count the tribe of Levi or include them in the census of the children of Israel.
items.mechanism: divine command reported to Moses (1:48, 'For the LORD had spoken unto Moses, saying')

items.quote: But thou shalt appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony, and over all the vessels thereof, and over all things that belong to it:
items.claim: Moses is told to put the Levites in charge of the tabernacle of testimony, its vessels, and everything that belongs to it.
items.object: Levites over the tabernacle of testimony and its vessels

items.quote: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all the vessels thereof; and they shall minister unto it, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle.
items.claim: The Levites are to carry the tabernacle and its vessels, serve in it, and camp all around it.
items.action: bear, minister unto, and encamp round about
items.mechanism: assigned cultic duty following exclusion from census
